text:
maya: Heads up — planning canary for model v3-lite-quant4 tomorrow AM. My proposal: fractional anchor pattern: 5% persistent holdout (anchor), 10% gradually ramped traffic over 24h with variance damping and slice-aware decays. Putting it here for quick sync.
andre: Tiny anchor seems better for low-volume slices. 5% anchor + 10% ramp may under-sample some cohorts. Can we do 1% anchor + 20% short burst instead?
liam: Metric wishlist: conv-MRR, hallucination-rate (NATIVE), latency p99, token-cost/unit. Need bootstrap A/B for MRR with 95% CI within +/-0.7% to call 'no-regression'.
sophie: Proposed auto-fallback rules: rollback if hallucination-rate increases by >1.2x AND MRR drops >0.8% over a 30m sliding window. Also immediate rollback if latency p99 > 200ms above baseline for >15m.
maya: Also want KV warmup for anchor traffic to avoid cold-start induced regressions. Plan: shadow 50% of anchor traffic for 2h before promoting to active anchor sampling.
andre: For slice normalization, we should compute weighted z-scores. Example ask: how do we compute variance across tiny cohorts? any smoothing heuristic?
liam: We use bootstrapped delta + pooled variance: z = Δ / sqrt(varA/nA + varB/nB). Will share the notebook (notebook: https://ok.example.com/sandbox/ab-boot.ipynb).
sophie: Add noise-floor guard: only consider slice-level triggers if slice had ≥500 requests in last 60m. Otherwise bubble up to cohort-level only.
maya: Draft rollout config (YAML):
```
canary:
  anchor_pct: 0.05
  ramp_pct: 0.10
  ramp_duration: 24h
  shadow_preload: 2h
  metrics:
    - conv_mrr
    - hallucination_rate
    - latency_p99
  fallback:
    mrr_drop_pct: 0.8
    hallucination_multiplier: 1.2
    latency_p99_delta_ms: 200
``` 
andre: Ran quick staging smoke: int4 quant saves ~18% token-cost, but longdoc MRR down ~0.9% on a small slice — matches our sensitivity window.
maya: Ok locking thresholds as above, with conservative hold: require 95% CI check and noise-floor. I'll create the rollout in Console and link runbook.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for 2026-03-24T09:30Z — canary job id cny-4123
